link_power_management_states.name: Active
link_power_management_states.description: Full operation; Flits flow at the negotiated data rate across all modules; sideband always-on.

link_power_management_states.name: Standby
link_power_management_states.description: Low-power standby; mainband quiesced; link state preserved; fast resume.
link_power_management_states.exit_latency_estimate: 0.5 ns at <=16 GT/s; 0.5-1 ns at >=24 GT/s

link_power_management_states.name: Deep low-power
link_power_management_states.description: Deeper sleep; re-entry re-trains the mainband (MBTRAIN); sideband remains the wake/management path.

low_power_modes_summary.L0_active: Full operational power; energy 0.5 pJ/b (Standard) / 0.25 pJ/b (Advanced).
low_power_modes_summary.L1_standby: Fast-exit standby (0.5 ns <=16G, 0.5-1 ns >=24G); state preserved; power savings >= 85% target.
low_power_modes_summary.L2_deep: Deep low-power; re-train on exit; sideband stays alive on vccaon.

power_rails.purpose: Always-on power — keeps the sideband and link-management alive across low-power states.
IO power for the mainband/sideband drivers.

fields.ucie_power_considerations: UCIe's very short on-package channel and single-ended source-synchronous signaling (no SerDes equalization, no line code) yield low energy-per-bit (0.5 / 0.25 pJ/b). The always-on sideband sits on vccaon so management/wake survives mainband power-down. Fast L1 entry/exit (sub-ns) keeps the chiplet link responsive; deeper L2 trades exit latency (re-training) for more savings.
fields.notes: UCIe provides a link power-management framework (ACTIVE / L1 / L2) with an always-on sideband on a vccaon rail. Energy efficiency is a headline KPI (0.5 pJ/b Standard, 0.25 pJ/b Advanced) with >= 85% low-power savings. Exit latency is data-rate-dependent (0.5 ns <=16 GT/s, 0.5-1 ns >=24 GT/s for L1).
